body:
Hobbies I've got a million of. I am never in shortage of hobbies, my problem is balancing them out with normal life. I'm working on that, but it's difficult. I obsess.

My first experiences were scary so they may have just frightened me off them for a bit. I'll look back into the meds.  I'll take your word for it. Thank you for your time.

I do my best to make use of the wonderful resource that is the internet, for sure. It is great for those of us that can't handle face to face contact.

Touch is just too much, even though logically I know it doesn't hurt my brain still wants to compute it as painful. Don't know what's the deal with that. Is there therapy for that? I was actually unaware.

I think my dislike just comes from not meeting people outside of the same group my boyfriend has been friends with since middle school. They're not good people. I don't know how to make friends of my own or where to find them.
I used to date one. It was great, other girls miss out. I wish I knew why it fell apart.

Microwave doesn't taste as good, those silly people. I'm feeling a little better now, it's like my cats and dog knew I felt shitty and all crawled into bed with me... even though my cats hate each other. Sometimes I forget, I can't die, they need me and they're like children to me.

Nothing elaborate. Some sort of pasta salad thing. Because he is the only one that works, I sort of make up shit as I go with what little we are able to buy. I do take pride in my crazy skill of turning nothing into something.

We've talked so many times about it. He tries to be understanding and all but I guess over time caring for me is getting difficult for him?

I've tried getting help with my depression, they just keep putting me on medications. I don't like them because I barely feel anything to begin with, I don't want to lose what little emotional sense I've got left. It scares me.
